queries.result: The Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) describes official survey/map products and its historical ownership-map mandate. Its official map index names Qalyubia/Banha map-sheet coverage but the entries are topographic/cartographic map products, not an open cadastral register. No primary Banha/Qalyubia parcel-registration workflow or ownership-map viewer was found.
